items.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 ships in bizarre 8-motherboard bundle — retailers hold GPUs hostage similar to the crypto boom
items.description: Taiwanese ecommerce platform PChome24h is packaging RTX 5090 GPUs with a crazy number of motherboards, entry-to-mid-range GPUs, and several other components. While interesting, these combos are alarming as they show the direction that the PC building industry is headed.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The AI-driven memory apocalypse has made computer parts so expensive that the average buyer has stopped building PCs. Multiple research firms have already said that, but we’re now seeing it in action in the market. Uniko’s Hardware shared on X four crazy combos of RTX 5090 GPUs being sold on the Taiwanese e-commerce platform PChome24h.Some of the GPUs that come with a lot of "freebies" include the Asus ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090, Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 Master, MSI GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC, and a Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 AI Box external graphics card. These items are priced in NTD, but we’ll list them below, including their retail prices in dollars (NTD 32.25 = USD $1 exchange rate) and the included items.As we can see, even though GPU prices are quite inflated, many of them come with enough freebies that you can start building one high-end system and three to five entry-level gaming rigs. They’re still priced relatively high compared to Amazon or Newegg in the U.S., though, but we have to keep in mind that Taiwan is a different market, so there will likely be variations in prices plus VAT.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Swipe to scroll horizontally Combo Combo Price (NTD) Combo Price (USD) Inclusions Qty Amazon/Newegg Unit Price (USD) Value (USD) Asus ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090 Combo 248,990.00 7,720.62 Asus ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090 1 4,829.00 4,829.00 - - - Asus Dual Radeon RX 9060 XT 4 79.00 316.00 Total Value - - - - - 5,145.00 Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 Master Combo 241,290.00 7,481.86 Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 Master 1 4,995 4,995.00 - - - Gigabyte B860M Gaming X WiFi6E 2 169.99 339.98 - - - Gigabyte Aorus Elite P1000W GP-AE1000PM-PG5 PSU 1 299.56 299.56 - - - Gigabyte X870E Aorus Master 1 589.99 589.99 - - - Gigabyte B850M Force WiFi6E 5 199.10 995.50 Total Value - - - - - 7,220.03 MSI GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC Combo 274,090.00 8,498.91 MSI GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC 1 4,799.00 4,799.00 - - - MSI MPG X870E Carbon WiFi 3 379.99 1,139.97 - - - MSI B650M Gaming Plus WiFi 2 232.30 464.60 - - - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 1 599.00 599.00 Total Value - - - - - 7,002.57 Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 AI Box Combo 267,090.00 8,281.86 Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 AI Box 1 4,499.99 4,499.99 - - - Gigabyte X870E Aorus Master 1 589.99 589.99 - - - Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Gaming OC 8G 2 389.99 779.98 - - - Gigabyte B850M Force WiFi6E 3 199.10 597.30 Total Value - - - - - 6,467.26 While this might be an amusing piece of trivia for some people, it’s actually evidence of a disturbing trend in the PC building industry. Multiple research firms have been saying that the market will contract by double digits this year, with the entry-level PC market being hit the hardest, and that it’s not expected to bounce back until 2029. These combos are just evidence of that, at least in Taiwan.buy one 5090, get seven free mobos?lets take a look at the msi 5090 gaming trio bundle priced at 274090ntd (~8500usd).it contains:- the 5090- three msi x870e carbon (42606ntd)- two msi b650m gaming plus wifi (8580ntd)- one amd 9950x3d (24150ntd)so the mobos + the cpu =… https://t.co/zTZupvfh2S pic.twitter.com/WeNuiGhYE5August 7, 2026That’s because sellers often put slow-moving products in a combo to help get their inventory moving. Given the number of motherboards, entry-to-mid-range GPUs, and other components included in these combos, it’s safe to say that these items aren’t selling and retailers are doing all these crazy deals just to free up capital. Only those with deep pockets who can afford to spend thousands of dollars on parts and combos like these are still buying PC parts. items.titleZh: Nvidia RTX 5090 以奇怪的8主板捆绑包形式出货——零售商扣留GPU，与加密货币热潮时期如出一辙
items.descriptionZh:
AI驱动的内存危机正在深刻改变PC硬件市场，台湾电商平台PChome24h上出现的一系列极端捆绑销售组合，成为这一趋势最直观的注脚。由于AI需求急剧推高内存和显卡价格，普通消费者已大幅推迟或取消PC升级计划，DIY组装机市场正经历严重萎缩。台湾零售商为了盘活积压库存，将RTX 5090旗舰显卡与大量主板、中低端显卡、电源等滞销部件捆绑销售，形成了令人瞠目的“买一送七”式套餐。

在这些组合中，最典型的是四款基于RTX 5090的套装。华硕ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090组合售价新台币248,990元（约合7,720美元），除核心的ROG Astral RTX 5090显卡（美国参考价4,829美元）外，还附带四张华硕Dual Radeon RX 9060 XT显卡（单价79美元，总价316美元），套餐内容总价值约5,145美元。技嘉Aorus RTX 5090 Master组合标价241,290新台币（约7,482美元），包含一块Aorus RTX 5090 Master显卡（4,995美元）、一块B860M Gaming X WiFi6E主板（169.99美元）、一个Aorus Elite P1000W电源（299.56美元）、一块X870E Aorus Master主板（589.99美元）以及五块B850M Force WiFi6E主板（每块199.10美元，共995.50美元），总价值达7,220美元。微星GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC组合售价274,090新台币（约8,499美元），内含RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC显卡（4,799美元）、三块MPG X870E Carbon WiFi主板（每块379.99美元）、两块B650M Gaming Plus WiFi主板（每块232.30美元）以及一颗AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D处理器（599美元），总价值7,002美元。技嘉Aorus RTX 5090 AI Box外置显卡组合则开价267,090新台币（约8,282美元），包含AI Box外置显卡（4,499.99美元）、一块X870E Aorus Master主板（589.99美元）、两张RTX 5060 Gaming OC 8G显卡（每张389.99美元）以及三块B850M Force WiFi6E主板（每块199.10美元），总价值6,467美元。

这些套餐尽管附带大量“赠品”，但整体价格仍明显高于美国亚马逊或新蛋等渠道的零售价，部分反映了台湾市场的汇率、关税和本地定价差异。然而，更值得关注的是其背后的市场信号。研究机构多次警告，2026年PC硬件市场将出现两位数百分比的下滑，其中入门级市场受创最重，且这一颓势预计要到2029年才有望扭转。上述捆绑销售正是这一预测的实证——被捆绑进套餐的主板、入门级显卡和电源等，均属于市场上流动性差的滞销品。零售商以旗舰显卡为诱饵，强行搭配这些难卖组件，本质上是为了释放积压的库存资金。

这一现象揭示了AI算力需求外溢带来的连锁反应：内存芯片产能被AI加速器吞噬，导致DRAM和显卡显存价格飙升，进而推高显卡整卡成本。普通消费者因预算超支而暂停或放弃装机计划，只有预算充裕、对最新旗舰显卡有硬性需求的用户仍在出手。对于DIY市场而言，这种“搭配销售”虽然短期内能为零售端周转资金，但长期反而进一步抑制了中低端产品的正常需求，加剧了市场结构性失衡。对高端玩家来说，这类组合或许提供了以相对合理的价格获得一套完整平台的机会，但对大多数消费者而言，它们恰恰是PC硬件市场进入漫长寒冬的又一个警示信号。

items.titleZh: Save $160 off AMD's ultimate gaming CPU combo, includes motherboard and chip cooler — $458 combo features Ryzen 7 9800X3D, B850 motherboard, and a 240mm liquid AIO
items.descriptionZh:
在组建高性能游戏PC时，处理器的选择往往决定了整机性能的上限。AMD推出的Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器凭借其出色的游戏表现，目前被视为市面上最强的游戏CPU之一。近日，Newegg平台推出了一款围绕该处理器打造的独家捆绑套餐，将Ryzen 7 9800X3D与微星MSI B850 Gaming Plus WiFi主板及MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240一体式水冷散热器组合销售，售价仅为458.99美元，相比单独购买这三件硬件节省了160美元，折扣幅度达到26%。这一价格在当前内存持续短缺、硬件成本普遍上涨的背景下，显得尤为具有吸引力。

Ryzen 7 9800X3D本身采用8核心16线程设计，集成高达96MB的L3缓存，这是其游戏性能领先的关键所在。得益于AMD的3D V-Cache垂直缓存堆叠技术，这颗处理器能够大幅减少游戏场景中因数据反复访问内存而产生的延迟，从而在竞技类、3A大作等对缓存敏感的游戏中展现出显著的帧率优势。与此同时，它并不仅仅局限于游戏场景，在视频渲染、代码编译等生产力任务中同样表现出色，称得上是一款兼顾娱乐与工作的全能型处理器。特别值得一提的是，Ryzen 7 9800X3D对内存频率和延迟不敏感，即使搭配规格较低的内存甚至单条内存，也能维持卓越的游戏性能，这为用户在内存价格高企的当下节省了一笔可观的开支，不必为追求顶级DDR5套件而额外投入。

捆绑套餐中的微星B850 Gaming Plus WiFi主板同样亮点颇多。它采用12+2+1相供电设计，既能充分释放Ryzen 7 9800X3D的完整性能，也为热衷超频的玩家预留了充足的功耗余量。存储扩展方面，主板配备四条DDR5内存插槽，最高可支持256GB容量，数据传输速率上限高达DDR5-8200，满足重度多任务处理和大型生产力软件的需求。存储接口则提供了三个高速M.2插槽（一个为PCIe 5.0规格，两个为PCIe 4.0规格）以及四个SATA III端口，兼顾了极致读写速度与大容量扩展需求。此外，主板还拥有一个PCIe 5.0 x16插槽，可完美适配旗舰级显卡，从而与Ryzen 7 9800X3D组成顶级的游戏平台。

散热方面，MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240是一款240mm规格的一体式水冷散热器，采用高性能水泵、加厚冷排以及更宽的水道设计，提升了冷却液流量和热交换效率。两个预装的120mm PWM风扇在保证出色散热性能的同时，也兼顾了低噪音运行。考虑到Ryzen 7 9800X3D本身发热量并不极端，这套水冷配置足以应对其默认状态下的散热需求，并为玩家提供了一定的超频散热余量。

该捆绑套餐将在Newegg平台持续销售整个月，但鉴于Ryzen 7 9800X3D本身的市场热度极高，这款高性价比的套装很可能在短时间内售罄。对于计划组装新电脑或升级现有平台的玩家而言，这套包含顶级处理器、功能丰富的主板以及可靠水冷散热器的组合，提供了一个难得的一站式解决方案，既省去了逐一挑选和比价的麻烦，也在当前硬件价格波动的市场环境中锁定了实打实的优惠。无论是追求极致游戏体验的玩家，还是有高性能生产力需求的创作者，这款捆绑套餐都值得认真考虑。

items.title: Amazon secretly circumvents community vote for massive AI data center using 45-year-old rules — Gilroy residents locked out of public comment window
items.description: Residents of Gilroy, California, were caught by surprise when an Amazon data center started construction in their city. Negotiations for the project started in 2020, with public comments open until 2024, but it flew under the radar.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The community of Gilroy, California, about 30 miles southwest of San Jose, was surprised when an Amazon data center started construction in their town last month. But as many projects like these have been suffering from opposition and delays across the country, the Wall Street Journal reports that this specific site avoided scrutiny by adhering to local zoning rules set 45 years ago.Amazon’s Gilroy project sits on a 56-acre piece of farmland between a Walmart Supercenter and the Gilroy Premium Outlets. The company and the city didn’t exactly keep the project secret when it started its application in 2020. In fact, there were disagreements between the tech giant and the city government during the process. The publication noted that some Amazon officials were frustrated by slow permitting progress, which was delayed by at least one year. At the same time, the city pushed back on some of the company’s requests, especially if they were no longer up for discussion.Roger Wehner, Amazon Web Services vice president of economic development, told WSJ that the site had gone through a long approval process, which required public notices and public-comment periods. However, when Gilroy resident Rosa Rodriguez wanted to state her concern about the damage a data center can do to a region suffering from drought, she was told that the comment period had already lapsed in 2024, long before data centers became a hot topic across the country.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Gilroy City Mayor Greg Bozzo said that other industrial projects that had a similar scale to the Amazon data center have previously been approved without resistance.“It didn’t bother them that a food-distribution center came to Gilroy without their engagement, but now it bothers them that a data center is coming to Gilroy without them having the possibility of engagement,” Bozzo said. You may like 142 AI data center protests staged in 42 states as public opposition increases AI data center developers target rural territory to bypass city construction bans and regulations Wisconsin residents file class-action lawsuit against Microsoft's 'world's most powerful AI data center' due to data center noise Still, he conceded the people are now more aware about data center developments and added, “We…have an opportunity to change the way that we do business in Gilroy. We’re adapting to the times.”The tech giant also said that it’s engaging more with the community, with Amazon officials claiming that they met residents directly and even hosted an open house where people can ask questions and leave comments. It also addressed fears that the development would cause a water shortage, which other data centers have already caused, saying the company is constructing a wastewater recovery system to supply its water needs and will even build a pipeline to bring wastewater from the source to its plant.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsBozzo also highlighted the benefits that Amazon will bring to the city, especially increased tax revenue, construction jobs, and a million-dollar donation towards a new fire truck. He also pointed out that the tech giant has been giving grants to non-profit organizations in the city, as well as sponsoring the annual Gilroy Garlic Festival.But at this point, it’s not the Amazon data center the people of Gilroy are having an issue with. Instead, it’s the fact that a major project that has the potential to have a major impact on the community has been approved without the knowledge of many residents. items.titleZh: 亚马逊利用45年前的规则秘密绕过社区投票建设大型AI数据中心——吉尔罗伊居民被排除在公众评议期之外
items.descriptionZh:
加州吉尔罗伊市（Gilroy）距离圣何塞西南约30英里，上月突然发现亚马逊的一座数据中心已在本地动工，这让当地社区颇感意外。近年来，全美各地类似项目因公众反对和监管拖延而频频受阻，但据《华尔街日报》报道，这一特定项目却巧妙避开了严格审查，其法律依据竟是该市45年前制定的一项分区法规。

该项目占地56英亩，原为农田，夹在一家沃尔玛超级中心和吉尔罗伊奥特莱斯之间。亚马逊并非完全秘密推进：早在2020年，公司就启动了申请程序，甚至在此期间与市政府产生过分歧。一些亚马逊官员对审批进度缓慢感到不满，项目至少被推迟了一年；市政府也对公司部分要求提出异议，尤其是那些已不在讨论范围内的事项。亚马逊云服务（AWS）经济发展副总裁罗杰·韦纳表示，该选址经历了漫长的批准流程，包括公告和公众评议期。然而，当居民罗莎·罗德里格斯想表达对数据中心可能加剧当地干旱问题的担忧时，却被告知评议期早在2024年就已截止，远早于数据中心引发全美热议的时期。

吉尔罗伊市长格雷格·博佐回应称，此前类似体量的工业项目均在同一规则下无阻通过。他指出，当年食品配送中心入驻吉尔罗伊未引发居民参与，如今数据中心却因公众缺乏参与机会而引发不满。不过他也承认，公众对数据中心的关注度正在上升，并强调“我们有机会改变吉尔罗伊的发展方式，顺应时代潮流”。博佐同时列出了亚马逊带来的实际利益：增加税收、提供建筑岗位、捐赠一百万美元购置消防车，以及持续向本地非营利组织提供资助并赞助一年一度的吉尔罗伊大蒜节。

针对居民最担心的干旱缺水问题，亚马逊表示正主动加强与社区沟通，除了直接会见居民、举办开放日供公众提问和建议外，公司还在建设一套废水回收系统以满足自身用水需求，并将专门铺设管道把废水从水源输送到数据中心。但从目前舆论核心矛盾来看，吉尔罗伊居民不满的并非数据中心本身，而是一个可能对社区命运产生重大影响的大型项目，竟在多数人毫不知情的情况下获得批准。这一争议折射出当下美国数据中心建设热潮中，科技企业如何利用历史遗留法规规避公众审查，以及传统社区在快速数字化进程中所面临的参与权与知情权缺失。

items.title: Intel's proposed orbital data centers would manage thousands of simple LEO satellites —two-tier network puts the brains of satellite constellations in higher orbit
items.description: Intel’s orbital data center architecture uses powerful higher-orbit satellites to manage LEO constellations, reducing reliance on terrestrial control centers.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter An Intel patent application published on August 6, spotted by Patentlyze, describes an orbital data center architecture that moves some of the computing used to operate massive satellite constellations off the ground and into space. The architecture proposes a two-tier satellite network in which a small number of more powerful satellites in higher orbits manage large constellations of relatively simple satellites in low-Earth orbit, handling much of the computing and constellation coordination normally performed by data centers and network operations centers on the ground.The application, US 2026/0230175 A1, is a continuation of an earlier Intel filing that was granted as US 12,542,604 B2 in February.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)Photonics and high-speed data movement is the next big AI bottleneckThe data center cooling state of playMassive AI data center buildouts are squeezing energy suppliesUltra Ethernet: The data center interconnection of tomorrowIntel’s proposed architecture is a different proposition from the orbital AI data centers now being pursued by companies such as SpaceX and Google, which aim to move AI compute itself into low-Earth orbit. SpaceX’s planned AI1 satellite and Google’s Project Suncatcher both envision running large-scale computing workloads in space, with the resulting data beamed back to Earth over high-bandwidth optical links. Intel’s orbital data centers, on the other hand, are designed primarily to serve the satellite network itself, acting as higher-orbit compute and control hubs for the much larger constellations operating below them.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: In large LEO constellations such as Starlink, Telesat Lightspeed, and Amazon’s Project Kuiper, thousands of satellites are constantly moving relative to one another and the Earth. While the satellites perform their individual tasks, the network itself still has to determine how traffic is routed, which satellites and links should communicate, how spectrum is allocated, and how the constellation responds to failures, interference, weather, and other changing conditions. Much of that network planning and control processing is traditionally handled by computers on the ground, with routing and operational instructions calculated at terrestrial network operations centers and then transmitted back up to the satellites. (Image credit: Intel)Intel says that this constant dependency on terrestrial infrastructure delays time-sensitive decisions, increases reliance on ground stations, and makes management harder as constellations grow into the thousands of satellites. Intel’s solution is to move part of that control and compute layer into orbit. Its architecture places more powerful satellites — which contain much more compute and storage capability than the individual LEO satellites — in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO), Geosynchronous Earth Orbit (GEO), or highly elliptical orbits, where they can maintain a broader and more persistent view of the LEO constellation below and take over tasks such as routing, mission planning, scheduling and network coordination without continually sending those workloads back to Earth. You may like Google is reportedly in talks with SpaceX to launch its orbital data centers China unifies tech sector to build grid-free orbiting satellite AI data centers, challenging Elon Musk's SpaceX SpaceX unveils 11-million-square-foot Gigasat factory, a new manufacturing facility for space-based data centers The proposed setup does not eliminate the need for ground stations. It just keeps satellite network control processing in space. Intel specifically describes moving mission planning and scheduling operations into orbit. The company also argues that offloading heavier network-management tasks to a smaller number of powerful satellites could allow operators to build simpler, cheaper LEO spacecraft. Under current architectures, individual satellites still have to actively participate in network-control functions, requiring additional onboard compute and communications hardware. There’s currently no indication that Intel is actively building the satellites. items.titleZh: 英特尔拟建轨道数据中心，管理数千颗简易低轨卫星——双层网络将卫星星座的智能核心置于更高轨道
items.descriptionZh:
英特尔公司于2025年8月6日公布的一项专利申请（公开号US 2026/0230175 A1）提出了一种“轨道数据中心”架构，旨在将大型卫星星座的运营计算从地面转移到太空。该申请是英特尔此前一份已获授权专利（US 12,542,604 B2）的延续申请，被技术媒体Patentlyze发现后引发关注。

在传统的低地球轨道（LEO）巨型星座中，例如SpaceX的Starlink、加拿大Telesat Lightspeed以及亚马逊的Project Kuiper，数千颗卫星持续围绕地球高速运动，彼此相对位置和与地面的关系不断变化。尽管每颗卫星本身执行各自任务，但整个星座仍需完成网络流量路由决策、卫星间链路调度、频谱分配、故障处理、干扰规避以及对天气等动态条件的响应的协调。这些网络规划和控制处理大量依赖地面计算资源——操作指令在地面网络运营中心计算后，再通过地面站上传至卫星。随着星座规模增至数千颗卫星，这种对地面基础设施的持续依赖带来了显著问题：时间敏感的决策被往返传输延迟拖慢，地面站的覆盖与带宽成为瓶颈，整个网络的管理复杂度急剧上升。

英特尔提出的解决方案是构建一个两层卫星网络架构。在较低轨道（LEO）上运行大量相对简单、廉价的卫星，而在更高轨道上部署少数功能更强大的“管理卫星”。这些高轨卫星可位于中地球轨道（MEO）、地球同步轨道（GEO）或高椭圆轨道（HEO），拥有比LEO卫星强大得多的计算和存储能力，能够对下方广袤的LEO星座保持持续、大范围的视野。它们可以接管原本由地面网络运营中心承担的路由规划、任务规划、调度、网络协调等关键职能，而无需将海量数据反复送回地球处理。该架构并不完全取消地面站，而是将卫星网络的核心控制处理逻辑保留在太空中，使地面站回归为数据上下行链路端点而非决策中心。英特尔特别指出，原本由地面系统完成的任务规划和调度操作将被移入轨道。

这一概念与SpaceX和Google正在推进的“轨道AI数据中心”存在本质区别。SpaceX规划的AI1卫星和Google的Project Suncatcher旨在将大规模AI计算负载送入低轨，在太空中运行大模型等繁重计算任务，并通过高速光链路将结果传回地球，本质上是将太空当作算力平台。而英特尔的轨道数据中心更偏重于卫星网络自身的运维管理，将高轨卫星作为低轨星座的“太空大脑”，服务于网络调度和控制，而非面向通用AI计算。

该架构的核心创新在于改变了当前星座管理中“每颗卫星都必须具备足够计算和通信硬件来参与网络控制”的设计逻辑。英特尔认为，通过将繁重的网络管理任务集中卸载到少量高轨管理卫星上，低轨卫星的设计可以大幅简化，降低质量、功耗和制造成本，使大规模星座更容易部署和扩展。同时，由于高轨卫星对低轨星座具有更持久和宏观的视野，控制决策可以基于更完整、更新的全局状态即时作出，显著减少对地面站的依赖，提高系统对故障和突发干扰的响应速度。

英特尔目前尚未透露任何实际建造或发射此类卫星的计划，该申请仅代表一种前瞻性的架构构想。如果这一思路得以实现，有望对未来的卫星通信网络产生深远影响：运营商或许能够以更低成本构建和维护超大规模LEO星座，同时获得更灵活、更智能的网络控制能力。它也为卫星网络与地面计算体系之间如何分工提供了新的思考方向——将控制平面移入太空，可能是解决巨型星座管理瓶颈的一种长期方案。

items.title: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
items.description: One hardware researcher, Christopher Domas (@xoreaxeaxeax on GitHub), is taking a different approach with the CPU Deoptimization leaderboard, which looks not to make Assembly instructions run as fast as possible, but as slow as possible to find the single instruction with the highest latency.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter To optimize how software runs on hardware, instruction latency analysis looks at the time it takes for low-level instructions to execute on a processor, either to optimize the architecture or to optimize applications to run on a particular architecture. One hardware researcher, Christopher Domas (@xoreaxeaxeax on GitHub), is taking a different approach with the CPU Deoptimization leaderboard, which looks not to make Assembly instructions run as fast as possible, but as slow as possible to measure the single instruction with the highest latency.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)CPU scaling with DLSSRyzen to the top: How AMD innovated in the gaming CPU marketHow ARM is working its way into PCsAMD CES 2026 gaming trends press Q&A roundtable transcriptThe winner here is fxrstor64, which took 62 seconds, or over 198 billion cycles, to complete. This instruction restores the state of registers used for SIMD calculations to a 512-byte memory location. To achieve the highest (slowest) score, Domas first used their own mmiotic tool to find a high-latency area in the internal PCIe fabric, then forced the CPU to load a 512-byte state from MMIO (Memory-Mapped I/O), essentially processing all of those 512 bytes as slow as possible. That took 74 billion cycles or just over 23 seconds to complete.Then, they went further "by starving the fabric while the load is in flight." They did so by using a series of 4-byte reads from another high-latency MMIO register, overwhelming the CPU's PCIe root complex and forcing the state restore to queue behind frivolous read ops. The next step is to use the AMX instructions available in Intel's Sapphire Rapids for xrstore64. The state area is increased from 512 bytes to 8KB, which could cause the instruction to hang for more than 1 trillion cycles.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Everyone's trying to make CPUs faster.I’m trying to make them worse.New project: CPU deoptimization.Searching for the slowest possible machine instructionsx86 single instruction record:198,002,498,236 cycles, 62 secondsThe assembly hall of shame: https://t.co/G4QnFQjsZx pic.twitter.com/WNaRPf2kRCAugust 7, 2026The x86 leaderboard is live on GitHub now, and it looks like Domas has ARM and RISC-V leaderboards planned, as well. There are a few rules for the runs. Domas says any setup is fine, so long as only the execution of a single instruction is scored. Interruptible instructions aren't allowed, nor is scoring emulated instructions run on the handler. All times are normalized based on the CPU's base clock, and the platforms were all run without hardware modifications.We're dealing with assembly code here, so the ranking is less about the specific instruction and more about what you're doing with that instruction. You may like Intel and AMD's new ACE CPU extensions bring an efficient AI-oriented instruction set to x86 Amazon cracks down on 'CPU waste' among engineers to amid AI CPU crunch [Updated] 30 years of CPUs at Tom’s Hardware — looking back on three decades of processors, from the Pentium II to Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Domas primarily used two CPUs for testing: the Intel Core i7-8559U and AMD Ryzen 7 5800H (inside the Trigkey S5). For the rdmsr instruction, however, they used a VIA Eden chip, which was a series of embedded processors from the early 2000s. The rdmsr command is used to read a model-specific register, or MSR. According to Domas, VIA "uses an undocumented register at 0x133 that gives wildly high response time." That command took 202 microseconds or 161,602 cycles to execute.This is not the developer's first foray into wild experimentation with low-level instructions. An earlier project, called movfuscator, is a C compiler that solely uses the mov (move) command.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.

items.titleZh: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
items.descriptionZh:
所有人都想让CPU运行得更快，但安全研究员Christopher Domas却反其道行之，他创建了一个“CPU去优化排行榜”（CPU Deoptimization leaderboard），专门寻找x86指令集中执行速度最慢的指令。这个项目并非为了优化性能，而是从反面探索处理器的微架构极限——通过人为构造极端条件，让单条指令的运行时间从纳秒级拉伸到数十秒甚至更久。

目前，x86指令的“单条最慢纪录”由`fxrstor64`保持，耗时62秒，约合1980亿个时钟周期（精确值为198,002,498,236周期）。这条指令原本用于将SIMD计算所需的寄存器状态从一段512字节的内存位置恢复出来。Domas的加速变慢方法分为两步：首先，他使用自己开发的`mmiotic`工具，在CPU内部的PCIe总线结构中定位到高延迟内存区域；然后，强制CPU从MMIO（内存映射I/O）空间加载这512字节的状态。由于MMIO访问本身极慢，这一步就消耗了约740亿周期（约23秒）。更巧妙的是，他进一步在加载进行中“饿死”总线——通过从另一个高延迟MMIO寄存器发起一连串4字节读取请求，压垮CPU的PCIe根复合体（root complex），使`fxrstor64`的状态恢复操作被迫排队等待那些毫无意义的读取完成，从而将延迟推到极限。

这项测试并非简单的赛跑，而是有严格规则：只对单条指令的执行计分，不允许可中断的指令，也不允许模拟指令由处理程序执行；所有结果按CPU基频归一化，且不得修改硬件。Domas主要使用Intel Core i7-8559U和AMD Ryzen 7 5800H（集成在Trigkey S5迷你主机中）进行测试。有趣的是，排行榜上另一个慢速指令`rdmsr`（读取模型特定寄存器）使用的是VIA Eden嵌入式处理器——一款21世纪初的芯片，其未公开的寄存器地址0x133响应时间极高，单次执行耗时202微秒（约161,602周期），虽然远不及`fxrstor64`的壮观，但在老旧架构上发现这种隐藏的“慢点”本身就极具研究价值。

Domas的下一步计划是利用Intel Sapphire Rapids处理器中的AMX指令集，执行`xrstore64`指令。届时状态存储将从512字节扩展到8KB，负载量暴增16倍，有望让指令挂起超过1万亿个时钟周期——那将是数分钟级的停顿。

这一项目看似恶搞，实则有着深层意义。它揭示了现代CPU中复杂的微架构行为：内存映射I/O、PCIe总线的排队机制、寄存器状态恢复的依赖路径等，都可能成为攻击者利用的时序侧信道。此前，Domas就曾开发过`movfuscator`——一个仅用`mov`指令就能编译C程序的编译器，展示了指令集的极端可塑性。这类研究不仅有助于安全社区理解处理器信号时序、防范时序攻击，也为编译器设计、虚拟化底层实现提供了反向思路。排行榜目前已公开在GitHub上，未来还计划增加ARM和RISC-V版本。它向硬件工程师展现了“最慢路径”同样值得关注，因为瓶颈往往隐藏在文档之外。

items.title: NASA modded space station's laptops so everyone could use the same charger — standardizing ISS chargers eliminated useless weight and reduced failure points
items.description: NASA ensured that all laptops destined for use in the International Space Station had the same 'cannon' power connector by implementing a modification.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter NASA ensured that all laptops destined for use in the International Space Station (ISS) had the same power connector. Engineer George Roush, who has a certain fondness for space tech, recalled details of this laptop modification earlier this week. Standardizing on a single ‘cannon plug’ meant that instead of requiring a multitude of different chargers, ISS visitors could plug into the onboard DC power outlets in a standard fashion. Roush took the photos shared below during a visit to the NASA Stennis visitor center.Since you all care (thank you for that, by the way) here's the answer: That's not an ethernet port at all! It's a modem port! Modem ports are useless on the ISS. So, NASA replaced this useless port with a new power port. Taking 9 different laptop chargers into space sounds… pic.twitter.com/ZLcqcEOHVfAugust 2, 2026Laptops destined to be used on the ISS would have their modem ports removed and replaced by the cannon plug you can see in the engineer’s photos. Of course, modem ports would be useless on the ISS, so that’s why they would be replaced with this modification. In space, every gram, every connector, and every failure mode matters, which makes this power standardization a smart move.Sources indicate that Lockheed Martin was contracted to make these modifications to the ThinkPads and other machines that ended up being taken to space. Roush also discusses networking/comms on the ISS, which relied on the MIL-STD-1553 system, rather than Ethernet.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Laptops with built-in telephony modem ports certainly date this story. However, we must remember that the ISS was constructed in the late 1990s when modems were still essential for PCs. The first crews docked in 2000.Original web sources are vanishingWhen refreshing his knowledge about this laptops-in-space mod, the space enthusiast and engineer was struck by another realization, which he found troubling. The NASA Stennis visitor center had barely any information about the laptops or the cannon plug modification that was on display. You may like NASA partners with Microchip to build next-generation spaceflight chips with 100x the power of current offerings We tested 20 wall chargers, from cheap to expensive, to find the best Best USB Chargers 2026 Turning to some online resources he remembers referring to previously, Roush noticed a lot of them had disappeared. “The old internet is dying, and with it, we risk losing a lot of useful history,” said the engineer. “I fear that the false belief of the 'eternal' internet will cause otherwise recorded history to be lost when the servers shut down.”Though some resources may still be able to be unearthed via the Wayback Machine, it seems perilous that so much web history is archived by a charity (The Internet Archive). In May, we reported that the internet is getting harder to archive because the AI boom has caused a storage crisis, with both NAND and mechanical drives facing shortages. This means skyrocketing storage bills to support the activities of the Wayback Machine.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsHP replaced all the ISS laptops in April 2026The astronauts in the ISS aren’t still using old modded laptops like the one showcased in the NASA Stennis visitor center. The latest updates came in April this year, with over 100 HP Z Workstations packing a mix of Core Ultra 9 processors and RTX Pro Blackwell graphics sent into orbit.HP talks about putting these PCs through two years of rigorous testing ahead of deployment. We don’t get much in the way of technical info from its release, but again, it was recognized that a single power standard was important. The computer maker supplies universal AC/DC power adapters with its latest crop of space laptops that are specially designed to function on both the ISS and Earth. items.titleZh: NASA modded space station's laptops so everyone could use the same charger — standardizing ISS chargers eliminated useless weight and reduced failure points
items.descriptionZh:
美国国家航空航天局（NASA）为保证国际空间站（ISS）上的笔记本电脑供电统一，曾对其进行了硬件改装，这一细节由太空技术爱好者、工程师George Roush在本周早些时候的社交媒体分享中重新进入公众视野。Roush在参观NASA斯坦尼斯航天中心访客中心时，拍摄了改装后的笔记本照片，并解释了背后的巧思：由于空间站在20世纪90年代末建设，当时内置电话调制解调器（modem）端口还是个人电脑的标配，但这一端口在太空中完全无用。于是NASA委托洛克希德·马丁公司，将计划随宇航员进入太空的ThinkPad等笔记本电脑上毫无用处的modem端口拆除，替换为一个标准的“cannon插头”电源接口。这一改动使得所有上天的笔记本都能以统一方式接入空间站舱内的直流电源插座，而不必为不同品牌的笔记本携带多达9种不同的充电器。在太空中，每一克重量、每一个接口、每一种故障模式都至关重要，这种电源标准化无疑是非常聪明的工程决策。

Roush还进一步介绍了ISS上的网络与通信系统，指出其并非依赖常见的以太网，而是采用了军用标准MIL-STD-1553总线系统。这恰好反衬出笔记本上民用modem端口的“多余”，也解释了为何NASA愿意为此专门改装硬件。

不过，真正让这位工程师感到不安的，并非这段技术史本身，而是网络资料的快速消亡。当他试图重温关于该改装的信息时，发现斯坦尼斯中心现场几乎没有相关展板说明，而许多他过去常看的在线资源已经消失。他说：“旧互联网正在死去，随之而来的是大量有用历史的丢失风险。我担心‘互联网永恒’的错误信念，会导致服务器关闭后本可记录的历史彻底湮灭。”虽然部分内容或许还能通过互联网档案馆的“时光机”找回，但大量网络历史仅靠一个慈善机构（Internet Archive）保存，令局面相当脆弱。今年5月，Tom's Hardware曾报道，因人工智能热潮引发存储危机，NAND闪存和机械硬盘都面临短缺，导致互联网存档成本飙升，进一步威胁到Wayback Machine的运作能力。

至于国际空间站上的电脑，如今早已不是照片中那种改装过的老式笔记本。2026年4月，惠普（HP）完成了对ISS全部计算设备的更新换代：100多台配备Core Ultra 9处理器与RTX Pro Blackwell专业显卡的HP Z系列工作站被送上轨道。惠普表示，这批PC在部署前经历了长达两年的严格测试。虽然官方并未公布详细技术参数，但一个关键点延续了当年NASA的设计理念——所有新电脑统一配备特制的通用AC/DC电源适配器，既可在ISS上使用，也可在地球上正常供电。从早期的“cannon插头”改装到如今的统一适配器，电源标准化始终是太空电脑设计的重要原则。

items.content: The global buildout of AI infrastructure reached a new milestone today — Firebird, an emerging AI cloud, launched the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure. Nikol Pashinyan, prime minister of the Republic of Armenia; Zhaslan Madiyev, deputy prime minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan; and David Allen, U.S. chargé d`affaires, a.i. in Armenia, attended the AI factory opening ceremony. AI factories are the foundational infrastructure for the AI era, providing the computing capacity needed to train, fine-tune and deploy AI models for every domain at scale. Building the Infrastructure to Create Intelligence at Home While AI services are available globally, countries also need the capacity to develop and run AI for their own languages, industries and national priorities. Firebird’s AI factory brings that capacity to Armenia, giving developers, startups, enterprises, universities and public institutions the compute to build and scale AI at home. Firebird plans to deploy more than 70,000 NVIDIA Rubin and Blackwell GPUs and 300 megawatts of AI infrastructure capacity in Armenia by the end of 2027, accelerating the country’s development as a center for AI research, advanced computing and innovation. At this scale, energy efficiency is essential. Built on the NVIDIA DSX platform, this AI factory integrates accelerated computing, networking, power and cooling as one codesigned system. Firebird’s AI factory is designed from the ground up to turn compute into revenue. With DSX, it can run up to 40% more GPUs on the same footprint, producing more tokens per dollar and extracting more value from every megawatt of capacity. A Magnet for Global AI, a Catalyst for Local Innovation Firebird’s ambitions extend beyond a single site. With NVIDIA’s support, the company is pursuing an approximately 2-gigawatt AI infrastructure roadmap spanning Armenia, Kazakhstan and additional markets. Firebird also announced that NVIDIA intends to invest in the company, following an earlier investment by CoreWeave this year. These investments will help Firebird expand its global infrastructure and operational footprint, and support its efforts to establish the largest and most advanced compute clusters across frontier markets. Delivered in just over six months, the Armenia AI factory demonstrates Firebird’s ability to turn ambitious infrastructure plans into operational AI capacity with exceptional speed. Schneider Electric provides the power infrastructure supporting Firebird’s AI factory in Hrazdan, helping Firebird meet its accelerated deployment schedule by rapidly delivering and setting up critical systems, including medium- and low-voltage switchgear, three-phase uninterruptible power supply systems and rack enclosures. This keeps the power buildout moving at the pace of the compute and provides a reliable foundation to bring NVIDIA accelerated computing online at scale. To support the facility’s thermal needs, Vertiv provided a cooling architecture combining chilled-water technology, advanced controls and Vertiv TrimCooler technology for efficient heat rejection. Vertiv’s iCOM CWM Chilled Water Manager centrally coordinates cooling resources, improving visibility, efficiency and responsiveness as demand shifts with AI workloads. Early demand is coming from AI-native companies including Perplexity, which is working with Firebird to access high-performance AI infrastructure for its AI agent platform and answer engine. As AI becomes essential infrastructure worldwide, Firebird’s expansion can help make the CIS region a magnet for global companies building and running AI — and a catalyst for local developers, researchers and enterprises. Powered by NVIDIA’s total AI factory platform — reference architecture, accelerated computing, networking and AI software — and deployed on Dell PowerEdge servers, the new Firebird AI factory will help Armenia’s builders turn energy into intelligence and connect their innovations to the global AI economy.

items.titleZh: Firebird在亚美尼亚启动独联体地区最大的人工智能工厂
items.descriptionZh:
全球AI基础设施建设今日迎来重要里程碑——新兴AI云服务商Firebird在亚美尼亚正式启动独联体地区规模最大的AI工厂，这标志着该地区首个由NVIDIA加速计算与戴尔科技高性能AI基础设施驱动的AI算力枢纽落成。亚美尼亚共和国总理尼科尔·帕什尼扬、哈萨克斯坦共和国副总理扎斯兰·马迪耶夫以及美国驻亚美尼亚临时代办戴维·艾伦共同出席了开幕仪式。

**AI工厂的时代意义**

AI工厂是AI时代的基础设施基石，为各领域AI模型的训练、微调和规模化部署提供必需的算力支持。在全球AI服务已触手可及的今天，各国仍需自主构建面向本国语言、产业和国家战略需求的AI开发与运营能力。Firebird的AI工厂将这一能力带到亚美尼亚，为本国开发者、初创企业、高校和公共机构提供本土化的AI构建与扩展算力，使"智能在本土诞生"成为可能。

**核心技术架构与创新亮点**

Firebird计划到2027年底在亚美尼亚部署超过7万块NVIDIA Rubin和Blackwell GPU，并建设300兆瓦的AI基础设施容量，加速亚美尼亚向AI研究、先进计算和创新中心的转型。在如此规模下，能源效率成为关键考量。该AI工厂基于NVIDIA DSX平台打造，将加速计算、网络、供电与散热集成为协同设计的完整系统，从底层架构上实现"算力即收益"的目标。借助DSX平台，同一物理空间可容纳的GPU数量增加多达40%，单位美元产出更多token，每兆瓦容量创造更高价值——这意味着在电力成本与机房面积不变的前提下，AI推理和训练的经济效益大幅提升。

**全球布局与资本助力**

Firebird的雄心不止于单一站点。在NVIDIA支持下，公司正在推进一项约2吉瓦的AI基础设施路线图，覆盖亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦及其他前沿市场。NVIDIA同时宣布有意投资Firebird，此前CoreWeave已于今年完成首次注资。这些投资将助力Firebird扩展全球基础设施版图，并在新兴市场建立最大、最先进的算力集群。

**极速交付与生态协作**

从动工到投产仅用时六个多月，亚美尼亚AI工厂的建成充分展现了Firebird将宏大基建规划快速转化为实际算力运营的能力。施耐德电气为位于赫拉兹丹的工厂提供电力基础设施支持，通过快速交付和安装中低压开关设备、三相不间断电源系统及机柜等关键设备，确保电力建设与算力部署同步推进，为NVIDIA加速计算的大规模上线奠定可靠基础。在散热方面，维谛技术提供了一套融合冷冻水技术、先进控制系统的冷却架构，并采用Vertiv TrimCooler技术实现高效排热；其iCOM CWM冷冻水管理器对冷却资源进行集中协调，随着AI工作负载变化动态提升可见性、效率和响应速度。

**市场反响与应用前景**

早期需求已来自Perplexity等AI原生企业，该公司正与Firebird合作，为其AI代理平台和答案引擎获取高性能AI基础设施支持。随着AI日益成为全球关键基础设施，Firebird的扩张有望使独联体地区成为全球AI建设与运营企业的聚集地，同时成为本地开发者、研究人员和企业创新的催化剂。这座由NVIDIA完整AI工厂平台——参考架构、加速计算、网络与AI软件——驱动、并部署在戴尔PowerEdge服务器上的新AI工厂，将帮助亚美尼亚的建设者将电力转化为智能，并将其创新成果接入全球AI经济体系。

items.content: The appeal of free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels has always been the way they make it easier to (re)discover classic films and series. But Roku’s latest experiment in the FAST space has less to do with traditionally produced entertainment and is entirely focused on giving viewers access to a constant source of AI-generated content.This week, Roku added four new channels to its library of streamable programming. Along with dedicated feeds for old episodes of Mad TV, Whose Line Is It Anyway?, and a variety of Black sitcoms, the platform also debuted a 24/7 stream filled with projects from Colin Petrie-Norris’ AI startup, Fairground. Partnering with Roku is a significant step up for Fairground, which launched in 2025 and is reportedly working on its own AI-generated adaptations of Robin Hood and Dracula. But watching the Fairground channel, you get the distinct sense that Roku hasn’t really gotten all that much out of the deal aside from the ability to say that it’s getting in on the gen AI craze.Like all FAST channels, Fairground AI Creator TV is filled with a curated selection of programming that you’re meant to watch somewhat passively. While you can scrub forward and backward a few seconds, there’s no way to choose exactly what kinds of videos the channel serves up. That might add a fun sense of discovery to the channel if it featured series and films that were actually riveting. But everything that I saw while watching for about an hour was more or less the same kind of short-form slop that text-to-video models have become known for.Aside from being produced with AI, there’s no consistent theme or genre to any of Fairground’s programming — all of which is made by a selection of content creators who have partnered with the company. Some videos are clearly generated by models trained on footage ripped from professionally produced anime, while others just look like terrible “lifelike” CGI. Surprisingly, there were semi-cohesive narratives to some of what I watched. I could follow what was going on in a “live-action” horror about people destroying a demon by making fun of it, and I got the sense that a fantasy about Greek heroes might have been inspired by The Odyssey.Image: Roku / FairgroundYou can tell from the videos’ length and the way their audio is mixed that there was some degree of post-production editing. But the videos’ general lack of visual polish makes it obvious that they were cobbled together from machine-generated clips rather than shots crafted by a human artist. And the overall shoddiness of Fairground’s programming becomes especially apparent whenever the stream cuts to an ad — this is a FAST channel — for one of the traditionally produced movies and shows Roku offers.Fairground’s website makes a point of emphasizing that it pays its content partners for their generations in addition to giving them an undisclosed share of the platform’s revenue. There’s no mention of which models are used to create Fairground’s content or whether it secured rights to use whatever training data is in the mix. But Fairground does stress that its programming is designed for “the living room, not the feed,” which says a lot about what kind of niche Petrie-Norris and his team are trying to carve out.RelatedPour one out for Roku CityAI slop movies are the new direct-to-video cash grabsIs paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?Most AI production startups have framed themselves as being poised to revolutionize the entertainment industry with technologies that will render traditional production workflows obsolete. Generally, the “Hollywood is so cooked” set insists that AI will soon be able to churn out films and shows comparable to a major studio’s, but that doesn’t really seem like the approach Fairground is leaning into. Rather than trying to be just as good or better than regular programming, it feels like Fairground simply wants its content to exist in the same general space as stuff that people might intentionally go looking for. Apparently, Roku thinks Fairground’s offerings are good enough to be platformed, which is depressing, but not altogether shocking as the company enters its Fox era.Fairgrounds’ content isn’t at all impressive, but its presence on Roku gives the startup a way to reach a massive audience of potential viewers. It’s easy to imagine an AI company seeing a business opportunity in the “looking for something mindless to play in the background” crowd, but this stuff doesn’t feel like something anyone would want to put on.
items.author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
items.titleZh: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
items.descriptionZh:
免费广告支持型流媒体电视（FAST）频道的一大卖点，在于它让观众更容易重新发现那些经典电影和剧集。然而，Roku最近在FAST领域进行的最新尝试，却与传统制作的娱乐内容关系不大，其核心是为观众提供源源不断的AI生成内容。本周，Roku在其可流媒体节目库中新增了四个频道：除了分别播放《Mad TV》老剧集、《Whose Line Is It Anyway?》以及多种黑人情景喜剧的专门频道外，平台还上线了一个24/7不间断播放的流媒体频道，内容全部来自Colin Petrie-Norris旗下AI初创公司Fairground的作品。

与Roku的合作对Fairground而言是一次重大跃升——这家公司于2025年成立，据报道正在开发基于AI生成的《罗宾汉》和《德古拉》改编作品。不过，实际观看Fairground频道后，你会明显感觉到，Roku这笔交易除了能对外宣称自己涉足了生成式AI热潮之外，似乎并没有获得太多实质性的好处。

和所有FAST频道一样，Fairground AI Creator TV提供的是经过策划的节目合集，适合观众被动观看。虽然你可以前后拖动几秒钟，但无法主动选择频道会播放哪种类型的视频。如果频道里播放的是真正扣人心弦的系列或电影，这种随机性或许能带来一种发现的乐趣。但在我观看的大约一小时里，所见内容几乎都是那种文本生成视频模型所特有的、千篇一律的“劣质短篇”（slop）。除了是AI制作的之外，Fairground的节目没有任何统一的主题或类型——所有内容都来自一批与公司合作的创作者。有些视频明显是由基于从专业动画中截取素材训练出的模型生成的，另一些则看起来像糟糕透顶的“逼真”CGI。令人意外的是，我看到的某些内容确实有半连贯的叙事。我能够看懂一部“真人”恐怖片中人们通过取笑恶魔来消灭它的情节，也感觉到一部关于希腊英雄的奇幻片可能受到了《奥德赛》的启发。

从视频的长度和混音方式可以看出，这些内容经过了某种程度的后期制作编辑。但视频整体缺乏视觉精细度，明显能看出它们是由机器生成的片段拼凑而成，而非由人类艺术家精心拍摄的镜头。Fairground节目的粗糙感在频道插入广告时尤为刺眼——毕竟这是FAST频道——与Roku提供的传统制作电影和剧集的广告相比，差距立现。

Fairground的网站特别强调，它除了付给内容合作方一笔固定报酬外，还给予他们平台收入中未披露比例的分成。网站没有提及使用哪些模型生成内容，也没有说明是否获得了所涉训练数据的使用权。不过，Fairground确实强调其节目是“为客厅设计，而非为信息流设计”，这充分说明了Petrie-Norris和他的团队试图开拓的细分市场。

大多数AI生产初创公司都把自己描绘成准备用技术彻底颠覆娱乐产业、让传统制作流程过时的力量。通常，“好莱坞已经完蛋”的那群人坚称，AI很快就能批量产出堪比大制片厂水平的电影和剧集。但这似乎并不是Fairground所采取的策略。它并没有试图与传统节目一样好或更好，而是感觉Fairground只是想让自己的内容存在于人们可能会主动寻找的同一类空间里。显然，Roku认为Fairground的内容足以被平台化，这令人沮丧，但考虑到公司正进入其“Fox时代”，倒也并不完全令人震惊。

Fairground的内容本身并不令人惊艳，但它在Roku上的存在，给了这家初创公司触达庞大潜在观众群的机会。很容易想象，有AI公司会在“想找点无脑内容当背景音”的人群中看到商机，但这样的东西给人的感觉是，似乎没人会真的愿意把它放出来看。

history.description: Taiwanese ecommerce platform PChome24h is packaging RTX 5090 GPUs with a crazy number of motherboards, entry-to-mid-range GPUs, and several other components. While interesting, these combos are alarming as they show the direction that the PC building industry is headed.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The AI-driven memory apocalypse has made computer parts so expensive that the average buyer has stopped building PCs. Uniko’s Hardware shared on X four crazy combos of RTX 5090 GPUs being sold on the Taiwanese e-commerce platform PChome24h.Some of the GPUs that come with a lot of "freebies" include the Asus ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090, Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 Master, MSI GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC, and a Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090 AI Box external graphics card. history.descriptionZh:
AI驱动的内存危机正在深刻改变PC硬件市场，台湾电商平台PChome24h上出现的一系列极端捆绑销售组合，成为这一趋势最直观的注脚。由于AI需求急剧推高内存和显卡价格，普通消费者已大幅推迟或取消PC升级计划，DIY组装机市场正经历严重萎缩。台湾零售商为了盘活积压库存，将RTX 5090旗舰显卡与大量主板、中低端显卡、电源等滞销部件捆绑销售，形成了令人瞠目的“买一送七”式套餐。

在这些组合中，最典型的是四款基于RTX 5090的套装。华硕ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090组合售价新台币248,990元（约合7,720美元），除核心的ROG Astral RTX 5090显卡（美国参考价4,829美元）外，还附带四张华硕Dual Radeon RX 9060 XT显卡（单价79美元，总价316美元），套餐内容总价值约5,145美元。技嘉Aorus RTX 5090 Master组合标价241,290新台币（约7,482美元），包含一块Aorus RTX 5090 Master显卡（4,995美元）、一块B860M Gaming X WiFi6E主板（169.99美元）、一个Aorus Elite P1000W电源（299.56美元）、一块X870E Aorus Master主板（589.99美元）以及五块B850M Force WiFi6E主板（每块199.10美元，共995.50美元），总价值达7,220美元。微星GeForce RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC组合售价274,090新台币（约8,499美元），内含RTX 5090 Gaming Trio OC显卡（4,799美元）、三块MPG X870E Carbon WiFi主板（每块379.99美元）、两块B650M Gaming Plus WiFi主板（每块232.30美元）以及一颗AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D处理器（599美元），总价值7,002美元。技嘉Aorus RTX 5090 AI Box外置显卡组合则开价267,090新台币（约8,282美元），包含AI Box外置显卡（4,499.99美元）、一块X870E Aorus Master主板（589.99美元）、两张RTX 5060 Gaming OC 8G显卡（每张389.99美元）以及三块B850M Force WiFi6E主板（每块199.10美元），总价值6,467美元。

这些套餐尽管附带大量“赠品”，但整体价格仍明显高于美国亚马逊或新蛋等渠道的零售价，部分反映了台湾市场的汇率、关税和本地定价差异。然而，更值得关注的是其背后的市场信号。研究机构多次警告，2026年PC硬件市场将出现两位数百分比的下滑，其中入门级市场受创最重，且这一颓势预计要到2029年才有望扭转。上述捆绑销售正是这一预测的实证——被捆绑进套餐的主板、入门级显卡和电源等，均属于市场上流动性差的滞销品。零售商以旗舰显卡为诱饵，强行搭配这些难卖组件，本质上是为了释放积压的库存资金。

这一现象揭示了AI算力需求外溢带来的连锁反应：内存芯片产能被AI加速器吞噬，导致DRAM和显卡显存价格飙升，进而推高显卡整卡成本。普通消费者因预算超支而暂停或放弃装机计划，只有预算充裕、对最新旗舰显卡有硬性需求的用户仍在出手。对于DIY市场而言，这种“搭配销售”虽然短期内能为零售端周转资金，但长期反而进一步抑制了中低端产品的正常需求，加剧了市场结构性失衡。对高端玩家来说，这类组合或许提供了以相对合理的价格获得一套完整平台的机会，但对大多数消费者而言，它们恰恰是PC硬件市场进入漫长寒冬的又一个警示信号。

在组建高性能游戏PC时，处理器的选择往往决定了整机性能的上限。AMD推出的Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器凭借其出色的游戏表现，目前被视为市面上最强的游戏CPU之一。近日，Newegg平台推出了一款围绕该处理器打造的独家捆绑套餐，将Ryzen 7 9800X3D与微星MSI B850 Gaming Plus WiFi主板及MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240一体式水冷散热器组合销售，售价仅为458.99美元，相比单独购买这三件硬件节省了160美元，折扣幅度达到26%。这一价格在当前内存持续短缺、硬件成本普遍上涨的背景下，显得尤为具有吸引力。

Ryzen 7 9800X3D本身采用8核心16线程设计，集成高达96MB的L3缓存，这是其游戏性能领先的关键所在。得益于AMD的3D V-Cache垂直缓存堆叠技术，这颗处理器能够大幅减少游戏场景中因数据反复访问内存而产生的延迟，从而在竞技类、3A大作等对缓存敏感的游戏中展现出显著的帧率优势。与此同时，它并不仅仅局限于游戏场景，在视频渲染、代码编译等生产力任务中同样表现出色，称得上是一款兼顾娱乐与工作的全能型处理器。特别值得一提的是，Ryzen 7 9800X3D对内存频率和延迟不敏感，即使搭配规格较低的内存甚至单条内存，也能维持卓越的游戏性能，这为用户在内存价格高企的当下节省了一笔可观的开支，不必为追求顶级DDR5套件而额外投入。

捆绑套餐中的微星B850 Gaming Plus WiFi主板同样亮点颇多。它采用12+2+1相供电设计，既能充分释放Ryzen 7 9800X3D的完整性能，也为热衷超频的玩家预留了充足的功耗余量。存储扩展方面，主板配备四条DDR5内存插槽，最高可支持256GB容量，数据传输速率上限高达DDR5-8200，满足重度多任务处理和大型生产力软件的需求。存储接口则提供了三个高速M.2插槽（一个为PCIe 5.0规格，两个为PCIe 4.0规格）以及四个SATA III端口，兼顾了极致读写速度与大容量扩展需求。此外，主板还拥有一个PCIe 5.0 x16插槽，可完美适配旗舰级显卡，从而与Ryzen 7 9800X3D组成顶级的游戏平台。

散热方面，MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240是一款240mm规格的一体式水冷散热器，采用高性能水泵、加厚冷排以及更宽的水道设计，提升了冷却液流量和热交换效率。两个预装的120mm PWM风扇在保证出色散热性能的同时，也兼顾了低噪音运行。考虑到Ryzen 7 9800X3D本身发热量并不极端，这套水冷配置足以应对其默认状态下的散热需求，并为玩家提供了一定的超频散热余量。

history.title: Amazon secretly circumvents community vote for massive AI data center using 45-year-old rules — Gilroy residents locked out of public comment window
history.description: Residents of Gilroy, California, were caught by surprise when an Amazon data center started construction in their city. Negotiations for the project started in 2020, with public comments open until 2024, but it flew under the radar.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The community of Gilroy, California, about 30 miles southwest of San Jose, was surprised when an Amazon data center started construction in their town last month. But as many projects like these have been suffering from opposition and delays across the country, the Wall Street Journal reports that this specific site avoided scrutiny by adhering to local zoning rules set 45 years ago.Amazon’s Gilroy project sits on a 56-acre piece of farmland between a Walmart Supercenter and the Gilroy Premium Outlets. The company and the city didn’t exactly keep the project secret when it started its application in 2020. In fact, there were disagreements between the tech giant and the city government during the process. The publication noted that some Amazon officials were frustrated by slow permitting progress, which was delayed by at least one year. At the same time, the city pushed back on some of the company’s requests, especially if they were no longer up for discussion.Roger Wehner, Amazon Web Services vice president of economic development, told WSJ that the site had gone through a long approval process, which required public notices and public-comment periods. However, when Gilroy resident Rosa Rodriguez wanted to state her concern about the damage a data center can do to a region suffering from drought, she was told that the comment period had already lapsed in 2024, long before data centers became a hot topic across the country.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Gilroy City Mayor Greg Bozzo said that other industrial projects that had a similar scale to the Amazon data center have previously been approved without resistance.“It didn’t bother them that a food-distribution center came to Gilroy without their engagement, but now it bothers them that a data center is coming to Gilroy without them having the possibility of engagement,” Bozzo said. We’re adapting to the times.”The tech giant also said that it’s engaging more with the community, with Amazon officials claiming that they met residents directly and even hosted an open house where people can ask questions and leave comments. It also addressed fears that the development would cause a water shortage, which other data centers have already caused, saying the company is constructing a wastewater recovery system to supply its water needs and will even build a pipeline to bring wastewater from the source to its plant.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsBozzo also highlighted the benefits that Amazon will bring to the city, especially increased tax revenue, construction jobs, and a million-dollar donation towards a new fire truck. He also pointed out that the tech giant has been giving grants to non-profit organizations in the city, as well as sponsoring the annual Gilroy Garlic Festival.But at this point, it’s not the Amazon data center the people of Gilroy are having an issue with. Instead, it’s the fact that a major project that has the potential to have a major impact on the community has been approved without the knowledge of many residents. history.titleZh: 亚马逊利用45年前的规则秘密绕过社区投票建设大型AI数据中心——吉尔罗伊居民被排除在公众评议期之外
history.descriptionZh:
加州吉尔罗伊市（Gilroy）距离圣何塞西南约30英里，上月突然发现亚马逊的一座数据中心已在本地动工，这让当地社区颇感意外。近年来，全美各地类似项目因公众反对和监管拖延而频频受阻，但据《华尔街日报》报道，这一特定项目却巧妙避开了严格审查，其法律依据竟是该市45年前制定的一项分区法规。

该项目占地56英亩，原为农田，夹在一家沃尔玛超级中心和吉尔罗伊奥特莱斯之间。亚马逊并非完全秘密推进：早在2020年，公司就启动了申请程序，甚至在此期间与市政府产生过分歧。一些亚马逊官员对审批进度缓慢感到不满，项目至少被推迟了一年；市政府也对公司部分要求提出异议，尤其是那些已不在讨论范围内的事项。亚马逊云服务（AWS）经济发展副总裁罗杰·韦纳表示，该选址经历了漫长的批准流程，包括公告和公众评议期。然而，当居民罗莎·罗德里格斯想表达对数据中心可能加剧当地干旱问题的担忧时，却被告知评议期早在2024年就已截止，远早于数据中心引发全美热议的时期。

吉尔罗伊市长格雷格·博佐回应称，此前类似体量的工业项目均在同一规则下无阻通过。他指出，当年食品配送中心入驻吉尔罗伊未引发居民参与，如今数据中心却因公众缺乏参与机会而引发不满。不过他也承认，公众对数据中心的关注度正在上升，并强调“我们有机会改变吉尔罗伊的发展方式，顺应时代潮流”。博佐同时列出了亚马逊带来的实际利益：增加税收、提供建筑岗位、捐赠一百万美元购置消防车，以及持续向本地非营利组织提供资助并赞助一年一度的吉尔罗伊大蒜节。

针对居民最担心的干旱缺水问题，亚马逊表示正主动加强与社区沟通，除了直接会见居民、举办开放日供公众提问和建议外，公司还在建设一套废水回收系统以满足自身用水需求，并将专门铺设管道把废水从水源输送到数据中心。但从目前舆论核心矛盾来看，吉尔罗伊居民不满的并非数据中心本身，而是一个可能对社区命运产生重大影响的大型项目，竟在多数人毫不知情的情况下获得批准。这一争议折射出当下美国数据中心建设热潮中，科技企业如何利用历史遗留法规规避公众审查，以及传统社区在快速数字化进程中所面临的参与权与知情权缺失。

history.title: Intel's proposed orbital data centers would manage thousands of simple LEO satellites —two-tier network puts the brains of satellite constellations in higher orbit
history.description: Intel’s orbital data center architecture uses powerful higher-orbit satellites to manage LEO constellations, reducing reliance on terrestrial control centers.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter An Intel patent application published on August 6, spotted by Patentlyze, describes an orbital data center architecture that moves some of the computing used to operate massive satellite constellations off the ground and into space. The architecture proposes a two-tier satellite network in which a small number of more powerful satellites in higher orbits manage large constellations of relatively simple satellites in low-Earth orbit, handling much of the computing and constellation coordination normally performed by data centers and network operations centers on the ground.The application, US 2026/0230175 A1, is a continuation of an earlier Intel filing that was granted as US 12,542,604 B2 in February.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)Photonics and high-speed data movement is the next big AI bottleneckThe data center cooling state of playMassive AI data center buildouts are squeezing energy suppliesUltra Ethernet: The data center interconnection of tomorrowIntel’s proposed architecture is a different proposition from the orbital AI data centers now being pursued by companies such as SpaceX and Google, which aim to move AI compute itself into low-Earth orbit. SpaceX’s planned AI1 satellite and Google’s Project Suncatcher both envision running large-scale computing workloads in space, with the resulting data beamed back to Earth over high-bandwidth optical links. Intel’s orbital data centers, on the other hand, are designed primarily to serve the satellite network itself, acting as higher-orbit compute and control hubs for the much larger constellations operating below them.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: In large LEO constellations such as Starlink, Telesat Lightspeed, and Amazon’s Project Kuiper, thousands of satellites are constantly moving relative to one another and the Earth. While the satellites perform their individual tasks, the network itself still has to determine how traffic is routed, which satellites and links should communicate, how spectrum is allocated, and how the constellation responds to failures, interference, weather, and other changing conditions. Much of that network planning and control processing is traditionally handled by computers on the ground, with routing and operational instructions calculated at terrestrial network operations centers and then transmitted back up to the satellites. (Image credit: Intel)Intel says that this constant dependency on terrestrial infrastructure delays time-sensitive decisions, increases reliance on ground stations, and makes management harder as constellations grow into the thousands of satellites. Intel’s solution is to move part of that control and compute layer into orbit. Its architecture places more powerful satellites — which contain much more compute and storage capability than the individual LEO satellites — in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO), Geosynchronous Earth Orbit (GEO), or highly elliptical orbits, where they can maintain a broader and more persistent view of the LEO constellation below and take over tasks such as routing, mission planning, scheduling and network coordination without continually sending those workloads back to Earth. You may like Google is reportedly in talks with SpaceX to launch its orbital data centers China unifies tech sector to build grid-free orbiting satellite AI data centers, challenging Elon Musk's SpaceX SpaceX unveils 11-million-square-foot Gigasat factory, a new manufacturing facility for space-based data centers The proposed setup does not eliminate the need for ground stations. It just keeps satellite network control processing in space. Intel specifically describes moving mission planning and scheduling operations into orbit. The company also argues that offloading heavier network-management tasks to a smaller number of powerful satellites could allow operators to build simpler, cheaper LEO spacecraft. Under current architectures, individual satellites still have to actively participate in network-control functions, requiring additional onboard compute and communications hardware. There’s currently no indication that Intel is actively building the satellites. history.titleZh: 英特尔拟建轨道数据中心，管理数千颗简易低轨卫星——双层网络将卫星星座的智能核心置于更高轨道
history.descriptionZh:
英特尔公司于2025年8月6日公布的一项专利申请（公开号US 2026/0230175 A1）提出了一种“轨道数据中心”架构，旨在将大型卫星星座的运营计算从地面转移到太空。该申请是英特尔此前一份已获授权专利（US 12,542,604 B2）的延续申请，被技术媒体Patentlyze发现后引发关注。

在传统的低地球轨道（LEO）巨型星座中，例如SpaceX的Starlink、加拿大Telesat Lightspeed以及亚马逊的Project Kuiper，数千颗卫星持续围绕地球高速运动，彼此相对位置和与地面的关系不断变化。尽管每颗卫星本身执行各自任务，但整个星座仍需完成网络流量路由决策、卫星间链路调度、频谱分配、故障处理、干扰规避以及对天气等动态条件的响应的协调。这些网络规划和控制处理大量依赖地面计算资源——操作指令在地面网络运营中心计算后，再通过地面站上传至卫星。随着星座规模增至数千颗卫星，这种对地面基础设施的持续依赖带来了显著问题：时间敏感的决策被往返传输延迟拖慢，地面站的覆盖与带宽成为瓶颈，整个网络的管理复杂度急剧上升。

英特尔提出的解决方案是构建一个两层卫星网络架构。在较低轨道（LEO）上运行大量相对简单、廉价的卫星，而在更高轨道上部署少数功能更强大的“管理卫星”。这些高轨卫星可位于中地球轨道（MEO）、地球同步轨道（GEO）或高椭圆轨道（HEO），拥有比LEO卫星强大得多的计算和存储能力，能够对下方广袤的LEO星座保持持续、大范围的视野。它们可以接管原本由地面网络运营中心承担的路由规划、任务规划、调度、网络协调等关键职能，而无需将海量数据反复送回地球处理。该架构并不完全取消地面站，而是将卫星网络的核心控制处理逻辑保留在太空中，使地面站回归为数据上下行链路端点而非决策中心。英特尔特别指出，原本由地面系统完成的任务规划和调度操作将被移入轨道。

这一概念与SpaceX和Google正在推进的“轨道AI数据中心”存在本质区别。SpaceX规划的AI1卫星和Google的Project Suncatcher旨在将大规模AI计算负载送入低轨，在太空中运行大模型等繁重计算任务，并通过高速光链路将结果传回地球，本质上是将太空当作算力平台。而英特尔的轨道数据中心更偏重于卫星网络自身的运维管理，将高轨卫星作为低轨星座的“太空大脑”，服务于网络调度和控制，而非面向通用AI计算。

该架构的核心创新在于改变了当前星座管理中“每颗卫星都必须具备足够计算和通信硬件来参与网络控制”的设计逻辑。英特尔认为，通过将繁重的网络管理任务集中卸载到少量高轨管理卫星上，低轨卫星的设计可以大幅简化，降低质量、功耗和制造成本，使大规模星座更容易部署和扩展。同时，由于高轨卫星对低轨星座具有更持久和宏观的视野，控制决策可以基于更完整、更新的全局状态即时作出，显著减少对地面站的依赖，提高系统对故障和突发干扰的响应速度。

英特尔目前尚未透露任何实际建造或发射此类卫星的计划，该申请仅代表一种前瞻性的架构构想。如果这一思路得以实现，有望对未来的卫星通信网络产生深远影响：运营商或许能够以更低成本构建和维护超大规模LEO星座，同时获得更灵活、更智能的网络控制能力。它也为卫星网络与地面计算体系之间如何分工提供了新的思考方向——将控制平面移入太空，可能是解决巨型星座管理瓶颈的一种长期方案。

history.title: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
history.description: One hardware researcher, Christopher Domas (@xoreaxeaxeax on GitHub), is taking a different approach with the CPU Deoptimization leaderboard, which looks not to make Assembly instructions run as fast as possible, but as slow as possible to find the single instruction with the highest latency.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter To optimize how software runs on hardware, instruction latency analysis looks at the time it takes for low-level instructions to execute on a processor, either to optimize the architecture or to optimize applications to run on a particular architecture. One hardware researcher, Christopher Domas (@xoreaxeaxeax on GitHub), is taking a different approach with the CPU Deoptimization leaderboard, which looks not to make Assembly instructions run as fast as possible, but as slow as possible to measure the single instruction with the highest latency.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)CPU scaling with DLSSRyzen to the top: How AMD innovated in the gaming CPU marketHow ARM is working its way into PCsAMD CES 2026 gaming trends press Q&A roundtable transcriptThe winner here is fxrstor64, which took 62 seconds, or over 198 billion cycles, to complete. This instruction restores the state of registers used for SIMD calculations to a 512-byte memory location. To achieve the highest (slowest) score, Domas first used their own mmiotic tool to find a high-latency area in the internal PCIe fabric, then forced the CPU to load a 512-byte state from MMIO (Memory-Mapped I/O), essentially processing all of those 512 bytes as slow as possible. That took 74 billion cycles or just over 23 seconds to complete.Then, they went further "by starving the fabric while the load is in flight." They did so by using a series of 4-byte reads from another high-latency MMIO register, overwhelming the CPU's PCIe root complex and forcing the state restore to queue behind frivolous read ops. The next step is to use the AMX instructions available in Intel's Sapphire Rapids for xrstore64. The state area is increased from 512 bytes to 8KB, which could cause the instruction to hang for more than 1 trillion cycles.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Everyone's trying to make CPUs faster.I’m trying to make them worse.New project: CPU deoptimization.Searching for the slowest possible machine instructionsx86 single instruction record:198,002,498,236 cycles, 62 secondsThe assembly hall of shame: https://t.co/G4QnFQjsZx pic.twitter.com/WNaRPf2kRCAugust 7, 2026The x86 leaderboard is live on GitHub now, and it looks like Domas has ARM and RISC-V leaderboards planned, as well. There are a few rules for the runs. Domas says any setup is fine, so long as only the execution of a single instruction is scored. Interruptible instructions aren't allowed, nor is scoring emulated instructions run on the handler. All times are normalized based on the CPU's base clock, and the platforms were all run without hardware modifications.We're dealing with assembly code here, so the ranking is less about the specific instruction and more about what you're doing with that instruction. You may like Intel and AMD's new ACE CPU extensions bring an efficient AI-oriented instruction set to x86 Amazon cracks down on 'CPU waste' among engineers to amid AI CPU crunch [Updated] 30 years of CPUs at Tom’s Hardware — looking back on three decades of processors, from the Pentium II to Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Domas primarily used two CPUs for testing: the Intel Core i7-8559U and AMD Ryzen 7 5800H (inside the Trigkey S5). For the rdmsr instruction, however, they used a VIA Eden chip, which was a series of embedded processors from the early 2000s. The rdmsr command is used to read a model-specific register, or MSR. According to Domas, VIA "uses an undocumented register at 0x133 that gives wildly high response time." That command took 202 microseconds or 161,602 cycles to execute.This is not the developer's first foray into wild experimentation with low-level instructions. history.titleZh: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
history.descriptionZh:
所有人都想让CPU运行得更快，但安全研究员Christopher Domas却反其道行之，他创建了一个“CPU去优化排行榜”（CPU Deoptimization leaderboard），专门寻找x86指令集中执行速度最慢的指令。这个项目并非为了优化性能，而是从反面探索处理器的微架构极限——通过人为构造极端条件，让单条指令的运行时间从纳秒级拉伸到数十秒甚至更久。

目前，x86指令的“单条最慢纪录”由`fxrstor64`保持，耗时62秒，约合1980亿个时钟周期（精确值为198,002,498,236周期）。这条指令原本用于将SIMD计算所需的寄存器状态从一段512字节的内存位置恢复出来。Domas的加速变慢方法分为两步：首先，他使用自己开发的`mmiotic`工具，在CPU内部的PCIe总线结构中定位到高延迟内存区域；然后，强制CPU从MMIO（内存映射I/O）空间加载这512字节的状态。由于MMIO访问本身极慢，这一步就消耗了约740亿周期（约23秒）。更巧妙的是，他进一步在加载进行中“饿死”总线——通过从另一个高延迟MMIO寄存器发起一连串4字节读取请求，压垮CPU的PCIe根复合体（root complex），使`fxrstor64`的状态恢复操作被迫排队等待那些毫无意义的读取完成，从而将延迟推到极限。

这项测试并非简单的赛跑，而是有严格规则：只对单条指令的执行计分，不允许可中断的指令，也不允许模拟指令由处理程序执行；所有结果按CPU基频归一化，且不得修改硬件。Domas主要使用Intel Core i7-8559U和AMD Ryzen 7 5800H（集成在Trigkey S5迷你主机中）进行测试。有趣的是，排行榜上另一个慢速指令`rdmsr`（读取模型特定寄存器）使用的是VIA Eden嵌入式处理器——一款21世纪初的芯片，其未公开的寄存器地址0x133响应时间极高，单次执行耗时202微秒（约161,602周期），虽然远不及`fxrstor64`的壮观，但在老旧架构上发现这种隐藏的“慢点”本身就极具研究价值。

Domas的下一步计划是利用Intel Sapphire Rapids处理器中的AMX指令集，执行`xrstore64`指令。届时状态存储将从512字节扩展到8KB，负载量暴增16倍，有望让指令挂起超过1万亿个时钟周期——那将是数分钟级的停顿。

这一项目看似恶搞，实则有着深层意义。它揭示了现代CPU中复杂的微架构行为：内存映射I/O、PCIe总线的排队机制、寄存器状态恢复的依赖路径等，都可能成为攻击者利用的时序侧信道。此前，Domas就曾开发过`movfuscator`——一个仅用`mov`指令就能编译C程序的编译器，展示了指令集的极端可塑性。这类研究不仅有助于安全社区理解处理器信号时序、防范时序攻击，也为编译器设计、虚拟化底层实现提供了反向思路。排行榜目前已公开在GitHub上，未来还计划增加ARM和RISC-V版本。它向硬件工程师展现了“最慢路径”同样值得关注，因为瓶颈往往隐藏在文档之外。

history.title: NASA modded space station's laptops so everyone could use the same charger — standardizing ISS chargers eliminated useless weight and reduced failure points
history.description: NASA ensured that all laptops destined for use in the International Space Station had the same 'cannon' power connector by implementing a modification.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter NASA ensured that all laptops destined for use in the International Space Station (ISS) had the same power connector. Engineer George Roush, who has a certain fondness for space tech, recalled details of this laptop modification earlier this week. Standardizing on a single ‘cannon plug’ meant that instead of requiring a multitude of different chargers, ISS visitors could plug into the onboard DC power outlets in a standard fashion. Roush took the photos shared below during a visit to the NASA Stennis visitor center.Since you all care (thank you for that, by the way) here's the answer: That's not an ethernet port at all! It's a modem port! Modem ports are useless on the ISS. So, NASA replaced this useless port with a new power port. Taking 9 different laptop chargers into space sounds… pic.twitter.com/ZLcqcEOHVfAugust 2, 2026Laptops destined to be used on the ISS would have their modem ports removed and replaced by the cannon plug you can see in the engineer’s photos. Of course, modem ports would be useless on the ISS, so that’s why they would be replaced with this modification. In space, every gram, every connector, and every failure mode matters, which makes this power standardization a smart move.Sources indicate that Lockheed Martin was contracted to make these modifications to the ThinkPads and other machines that ended up being taken to space. Roush also discusses networking/comms on the ISS, which relied on the MIL-STD-1553 system, rather than Ethernet.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Laptops with built-in telephony modem ports certainly date this story. However, we must remember that the ISS was constructed in the late 1990s when modems were still essential for PCs. The first crews docked in 2000.Original web sources are vanishingWhen refreshing his knowledge about this laptops-in-space mod, the space enthusiast and engineer was struck by another realization, which he found troubling. The NASA Stennis visitor center had barely any information about the laptops or the cannon plug modification that was on display. You may like NASA partners with Microchip to build next-generation spaceflight chips with 100x the power of current offerings We tested 20 wall chargers, from cheap to expensive, to find the best Best USB Chargers 2026 Turning to some online resources he remembers referring to previously, Roush noticed a lot of them had disappeared. “The old internet is dying, and with it, we risk losing a lot of useful history,” said the engineer. “I fear that the false belief of the 'eternal' internet will cause otherwise recorded history to be lost when the servers shut down.”Though some resources may still be able to be unearthed via the Wayback Machine, it seems perilous that so much web history is archived by a charity (The Internet Archive). In May, we reported that the internet is getting harder to archive because the AI boom has caused a storage crisis, with both NAND and mechanical drives facing shortages. This means skyrocketing storage bills to support the activities of the Wayback Machine.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsHP replaced all the ISS laptops in April 2026The astronauts in the ISS aren’t still using old modded laptops like the one showcased in the NASA Stennis visitor center. The latest updates came in April this year, with over 100 HP Z Workstations packing a mix of Core Ultra 9 processors and RTX Pro Blackwell graphics sent into orbit.HP talks about putting these PCs through two years of rigorous testing ahead of deployment. We don’t get much in the way of technical info from its release, but again, it was recognized that a single power standard was important. The computer maker supplies universal AC/DC power adapters with its latest crop of space laptops that are specially designed to function on both the ISS and Earth. history.titleZh: NASA modded space station's laptops so everyone could use the same charger — standardizing ISS chargers eliminated useless weight and reduced failure points
history.descriptionZh:
美国国家航空航天局（NASA）为保证国际空间站（ISS）上的笔记本电脑供电统一，曾对其进行了硬件改装，这一细节由太空技术爱好者、工程师George Roush在本周早些时候的社交媒体分享中重新进入公众视野。Roush在参观NASA斯坦尼斯航天中心访客中心时，拍摄了改装后的笔记本照片，并解释了背后的巧思：由于空间站在20世纪90年代末建设，当时内置电话调制解调器（modem）端口还是个人电脑的标配，但这一端口在太空中完全无用。于是NASA委托洛克希德·马丁公司，将计划随宇航员进入太空的ThinkPad等笔记本电脑上毫无用处的modem端口拆除，替换为一个标准的“cannon插头”电源接口。这一改动使得所有上天的笔记本都能以统一方式接入空间站舱内的直流电源插座，而不必为不同品牌的笔记本携带多达9种不同的充电器。在太空中，每一克重量、每一个接口、每一种故障模式都至关重要，这种电源标准化无疑是非常聪明的工程决策。

Roush还进一步介绍了ISS上的网络与通信系统，指出其并非依赖常见的以太网，而是采用了军用标准MIL-STD-1553总线系统。这恰好反衬出笔记本上民用modem端口的“多余”，也解释了为何NASA愿意为此专门改装硬件。

不过，真正让这位工程师感到不安的，并非这段技术史本身，而是网络资料的快速消亡。当他试图重温关于该改装的信息时，发现斯坦尼斯中心现场几乎没有相关展板说明，而许多他过去常看的在线资源已经消失。他说：“旧互联网正在死去，随之而来的是大量有用历史的丢失风险。我担心‘互联网永恒’的错误信念，会导致服务器关闭后本可记录的历史彻底湮灭。”虽然部分内容或许还能通过互联网档案馆的“时光机”找回，但大量网络历史仅靠一个慈善机构（Internet Archive）保存，令局面相当脆弱。今年5月，Tom's Hardware曾报道，因人工智能热潮引发存储危机，NAND闪存和机械硬盘都面临短缺，导致互联网存档成本飙升，进一步威胁到Wayback Machine的运作能力。

至于国际空间站上的电脑，如今早已不是照片中那种改装过的老式笔记本。2026年4月，惠普（HP）完成了对ISS全部计算设备的更新换代：100多台配备Core Ultra 9处理器与RTX Pro Blackwell专业显卡的HP Z系列工作站被送上轨道。惠普表示，这批PC在部署前经历了长达两年的严格测试。虽然官方并未公布详细技术参数，但一个关键点延续了当年NASA的设计理念——所有新电脑统一配备特制的通用AC/DC电源适配器，既可在ISS上使用，也可在地球上正常供电。从早期的“cannon插头”改装到如今的统一适配器，电源标准化始终是太空电脑设计的重要原则。

history.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
history.description: The global buildout of AI infrastructure reached a new milestone today — Firebird, an emerging AI cloud, launched the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure.  Nikol Pashinyan, prime minister of the Republic of Armenia; Zhaslan Madiyev, deputy […]
history.content: The global buildout of AI infrastructure reached a new milestone today — Firebird, an emerging AI cloud, launched the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure. Nikol Pashinyan, prime minister of the Republic of Armenia; Zhaslan Madiyev, deputy prime minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan; and David Allen, U.S. chargé d`affaires, a.i. in Armenia, attended the AI factory opening ceremony. AI factories are the foundational infrastructure for the AI era, providing the computing capacity needed to train, fine-tune and deploy AI models for every domain at scale. Building the Infrastructure to Create Intelligence at Home While AI services are available globally, countries also need the capacity to develop and run AI for their own languages, industries and national priorities. Firebird’s AI factory brings that capacity to Armenia, giving developers, startups, enterprises, universities and public institutions the compute to build and scale AI at home. Firebird plans to deploy more than 70,000 NVIDIA Rubin and Blackwell GPUs and 300 megawatts of AI infrastructure capacity in Armenia by the end of 2027, accelerating the country’s development as a center for AI research, advanced computing and innovation. At this scale, energy efficiency is essential. Built on the NVIDIA DSX platform, this AI factory integrates accelerated computing, networking, power and cooling as one codesigned system. Firebird’s AI factory is designed from the ground up to turn compute into revenue. With DSX, it can run up to 40% more GPUs on the same footprint, producing more tokens per dollar and extracting more value from every megawatt of capacity. A Magnet for Global AI, a Catalyst for Local Innovation Firebird’s ambitions extend beyond a single site. With NVIDIA’s support, the company is pursuing an approximately 2-gigawatt AI infrastructure roadmap spanning Armenia, Kazakhstan and additional markets. Firebird also announced that NVIDIA intends to invest in the company, following an earlier investment by CoreWeave this year. These investments will help Firebird expand its global infrastructure and operational footprint, and support its efforts to establish the largest and most advanced compute clusters across frontier markets. Delivered in just over six months, the Armenia AI factory demonstrates Firebird’s ability to turn ambitious infrastructure plans into operational AI capacity with exceptional speed. Schneider Electric provides the power infrastructure supporting Firebird’s AI factory in Hrazdan, helping Firebird meet its accelerated deployment schedule by rapidly delivering and setting up critical systems, including medium- and low-voltage switchgear, three-phase uninterruptible power supply systems and rack enclosures. This keeps the power buildout moving at the pace of the compute and provides a reliable foundation to bring NVIDIA accelerated computing online at scale. To support the facility’s thermal needs, Vertiv provided a cooling architecture combining chilled-water technology, advanced controls and Vertiv TrimCooler technology for efficient heat rejection. Vertiv’s iCOM CWM Chilled Water Manager centrally coordinates cooling resources, improving visibility, efficiency and responsiveness as demand shifts with AI workloads. Early demand is coming from AI-native companies including Perplexity, which is working with Firebird to access high-performance AI infrastructure for its AI agent platform and answer engine. As AI becomes essential infrastructure worldwide, Firebird’s expansion can help make the CIS region a magnet for global companies building and running AI — and a catalyst for local developers, researchers and enterprises. Powered by NVIDIA’s total AI factory platform — reference architecture, accelerated computing, networking and AI software — and deployed on Dell PowerEdge servers, the new Firebird AI factory will help Armenia’s builders turn energy into intelligence and connect their innovations to the global AI economy.

history.titleZh: Firebird在亚美尼亚启动独联体地区最大的人工智能工厂
history.descriptionZh:
全球AI基础设施建设今日迎来重要里程碑——新兴AI云服务商Firebird在亚美尼亚正式启动独联体地区规模最大的AI工厂，这标志着该地区首个由NVIDIA加速计算与戴尔科技高性能AI基础设施驱动的AI算力枢纽落成。亚美尼亚共和国总理尼科尔·帕什尼扬、哈萨克斯坦共和国副总理扎斯兰·马迪耶夫以及美国驻亚美尼亚临时代办戴维·艾伦共同出席了开幕仪式。

**AI工厂的时代意义**

AI工厂是AI时代的基础设施基石，为各领域AI模型的训练、微调和规模化部署提供必需的算力支持。在全球AI服务已触手可及的今天，各国仍需自主构建面向本国语言、产业和国家战略需求的AI开发与运营能力。Firebird的AI工厂将这一能力带到亚美尼亚，为本国开发者、初创企业、高校和公共机构提供本土化的AI构建与扩展算力，使"智能在本土诞生"成为可能。

**核心技术架构与创新亮点**

Firebird计划到2027年底在亚美尼亚部署超过7万块NVIDIA Rubin和Blackwell GPU，并建设300兆瓦的AI基础设施容量，加速亚美尼亚向AI研究、先进计算和创新中心的转型。在如此规模下，能源效率成为关键考量。该AI工厂基于NVIDIA DSX平台打造，将加速计算、网络、供电与散热集成为协同设计的完整系统，从底层架构上实现"算力即收益"的目标。借助DSX平台，同一物理空间可容纳的GPU数量增加多达40%，单位美元产出更多token，每兆瓦容量创造更高价值——这意味着在电力成本与机房面积不变的前提下，AI推理和训练的经济效益大幅提升。

**全球布局与资本助力**

Firebird的雄心不止于单一站点。在NVIDIA支持下，公司正在推进一项约2吉瓦的AI基础设施路线图，覆盖亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦及其他前沿市场。NVIDIA同时宣布有意投资Firebird，此前CoreWeave已于今年完成首次注资。这些投资将助力Firebird扩展全球基础设施版图，并在新兴市场建立最大、最先进的算力集群。

**极速交付与生态协作**

从动工到投产仅用时六个多月，亚美尼亚AI工厂的建成充分展现了Firebird将宏大基建规划快速转化为实际算力运营的能力。施耐德电气为位于赫拉兹丹的工厂提供电力基础设施支持，通过快速交付和安装中低压开关设备、三相不间断电源系统及机柜等关键设备，确保电力建设与算力部署同步推进，为NVIDIA加速计算的大规模上线奠定可靠基础。在散热方面，维谛技术提供了一套融合冷冻水技术、先进控制系统的冷却架构，并采用Vertiv TrimCooler技术实现高效排热；其iCOM CWM冷冻水管理器对冷却资源进行集中协调，随着AI工作负载变化动态提升可见性、效率和响应速度。

**市场反响与应用前景**

早期需求已来自Perplexity等AI原生企业，该公司正与Firebird合作，为其AI代理平台和答案引擎获取高性能AI基础设施支持。随着AI日益成为全球关键基础设施，Firebird的扩张有望使独联体地区成为全球AI建设与运营企业的聚集地，同时成为本地开发者、研究人员和企业创新的催化剂。这座由NVIDIA完整AI工厂平台——参考架构、加速计算、网络与AI软件——驱动、并部署在戴尔PowerEdge服务器上的新AI工厂，将帮助亚美尼亚的建设者将电力转化为智能，并将其创新成果接入全球AI经济体系。
